name: Nodo Importaciones
description: Uruguayan importer selling notebooks, PCs, monitors and phones online, with technical service. Offers delivery across Uruguay, same-day delivery in Montevideo and pickup at its Montevideo store.
description_es: Importadora uruguaya que vende notebooks, PCs, monitores y celulares online, con servicio técnico. Ofrece envío a todo el país, entrega en el día en Montevideo y retiro en su local de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Its Envios page states delivery to the whole country and same-day delivery within Montevideo.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the Montevideo store (Herrera avenue).

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Robots.txt content signals: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference, and it disallows training crawlers such as ClaudeBot and GPTBot. Do not use the site for AI training. Site describes itself as a wholesale supplier; its about page returned HTTP 403 to a generic fetcher.

sources.supports: Envios page: delivery to the whole country, same-day Montevideo, pickup at the store
Home page: notebooks, phones categories and cart
